summary: Assistant Teacher (niyukti 28.05.2022) ki seva 06.05.2026 ko khatam ki gayi — graduation mein 42% hain, 45% se kam. Petitioner ka kehna: NCTE ki 13.11.2019 ki notification ke anusaar jinhone B.Ed. mein 29.07.2011 se pehle pravesh liya, un par 45% ki shart lagu nahi. Graduation 1998, B.Ed. 1999.
status: 29.07.2026 ko court ne 25.04.2026 aur 06.05.2026 ke dono aadesh agli tareekh tak rok diye. Respondents ko 6 hafte mein counter affidavit dena tha.

timeline.text: Graduation (42%) aur B.Ed. — petition ke anusaar
NCTE notification: 29.07.2011 se pehle B.Ed. pravesh walon par graduation % ki shart nahi
Assistant Teacher ke pad par niyukti
Justice Pankaj Purohit: dono aadesh par roak, counter 6 hafte mein, agli tareekh 12.10.2026

pros: Pehli sunwai mein hi court ne petitioner ki baat mein "substance" maana aur dono aadesh rok diye (29.07.2026, para 9–11).
NCTE notification 13.11.2019: 29.07.2011 se pehle B.Ed. pravesh walon par graduation % ki shart lagu nahi, aur ye 29.07.2011 se hi lagu maani gayi.
Supreme Court, Manilal v. State of Rajasthan (2024 INSC 675): isi notification par appeal allowed.
Petitioner lagbhag 4 saal (2022–2026) seva mein raha.
cons: Uttarakhand ki bharti niyamavali ya vigyapan mein 45% alag se likha ho to State usi par tikegi — vigyapan aur niyam dekhna zaroori.
B.Ed. mein pravesh 29.07.2011 se pehle hua, iska kagazi saboot chahiye (1999 ki marksheet / admission).
Counter ki 6 hafte ki seema beet chuki — counter aaya ya nahi, dekho; aaya ho to rejoinder taiyaar karo.
disclaimer: Ye vishleshan Claude ne court ke 29.07.2026 ke order aur judgments database se banaya hai — advocate ka review zaroori. Petition/counter milne par aur gehra hoga. Koi jeetne ka % nahi.
